Extension exceptionnelle pour la compéti: Exceptional extension for the 'Nejma El I’lam' competition
ALGER — Dans le but d’offrir aux journal: ALGIERS — In order to provide journalists with a favorable framework to finalize their contributions, Ooredoo, in agreement with the competition jury, has decided to extend the deadline for submitting applications. Initially set for August 31, 2026, this date is now postponed to September 15, 2026.
Cette mesure s’inscrit en réponse aux so: This measure is in response to requests made by several journalists, who expressed the need for additional time to prepare and submit their files under the best conditions.
Thématique 2026 : intelligence artificie: 2026 Theme: Artificial Intelligence and 5G in Algeria
La 19e édition de la compétition 'Nejma: The 19th edition of the 'Nejma El I’lam' competition revolves around the theme: 'The impact of artificial intelligence and 5G technology on social and economic transformations in Algeria'.
Les participants sont invités à explorer: Participants are invited to explore the opportunities and challenges related to these innovations, as well as to analyze their repercussions on the country's economic and social dynamics. Works, written in Arabic, Tamazight, French, or English, must have been published or broadcast between August 15, 2025, and September 15, 2026.
Les journalistes souhaitant concourir pe: Journalists wishing to compete can submit their application via the dedicated platform ore.do/media-star-participation or by email to MediaStar@Ooredoo.dz. Ooredoo strongly encourages media professionals to take advantage of this extra time to submit their work before the September 15, 2026 deadline.
